observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 224.» (L28) in the left margin; in «p. 224.» the 2s are printed blotted. Beside L1, in the left margin, only a broken p stands; Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «148,1, addatur in margine p. 223 textus Arabici.»; the margin is kept as printed. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of E: 5 stands beside the first line of the title.
body L1-L5: the head E is set in a larger bold type and centred; the title is set in a larger type as a paragraph whose second and following lines are indented.
body L8: a point stands in the right margin after «et locum»; it is not a sign.
body L10: a point stands at the foot of the line after «vel numero»; it is not a sign.
body L23: the ō of «merōn» is printed with its macron joined to the top of the o.
body L27: a blot stands over the end of «columnis motuum»; it is not a sign.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
